cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Hi Shannon – how are you settling into your new flat?

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Yes, I am.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: My cousins are coming to stay for a couple of days, and I have to cook for them.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Well, there's plenty of places to buy food in Kite Place – it's the area by the harbour.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Well, neither of them eats meat but they both like fish.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: It's at the far end of Kite Place, so you have to go over the bridge and then it's on the

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: right.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: It doesn't close until four, but I'd recommend going earlier than that – it does run out

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: of some things.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: As long as you get there by 3.30, you should be fine. It's only 11 now, so plenty of time.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: I do, and I want to avoid all the plastic packaging in the supermarket!

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Well, there's a really nice organic shop there. Now what's it called …

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: it's the name of a flower. I know, it's 'Rose'.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Yeah – it sells vegetables and quite a lot of other stuff.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Well, as you reach the market, you'll see a big grey building on your left – I think it

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: used to be a warehouse.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Anyway, now it's a restaurant upstairs, but the ground floor has two shops either side of

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: the entrance and it's the one on the left.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: You can't miss it – there's also a big sign on the pavement so you can look for that.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Fine! I guess if I need anything else, I'll have to go to the supermarket.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Yeah – you should be able to get everything you need, but there's a minibus that goes to

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: the supermarket if you need it. It's purple and the number is 289.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: So what do you need to get at the fish market?

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: The salmon is always very good and the shellfish.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: I'm going to make a curry, I think, and I need about 12 prawns for that.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: It's a type of seaweed. I just ask for a handful and you fry it in butter. It's delicious!

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Great – it's always good to try something different.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: I'll see what beans they have in the organic shop and I think I'll get something for

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: dessert there.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: I'm not sure – they're not always ripe. I'd prefer a melon – it's bigger too.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Good idea.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: The owner also sells a lot of spices there that you can put in a curry, and things like

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: coconut.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: I know bread doesn't really go with curry but I always like to have some in case.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: As I said – all the bread is home-made and there's lots of variety.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: I like the brown bread myself.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Well – not that, but they have a whole range of tarts and the best are the strawberry

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: ones.

cues.speaker: ON
cues.text: Perfect – hopefully I won't even have to go to the supermarket!
